posts.caption: Year to August, as reported: applications approved 312 → 649; applications lodged 629 → 1,150; courts approved 456 → 945. The latest totals include provisional August and are floors. Padel Genie’s planning map updates as councils publish.
38 councils with more than 100,000 residents have no open padel court inside their boundary, as reported in October. Check nearby courts and the planning-pipeline preview on Padel Genie’s live map.
3,061 open courts across 891 clubs. The UK court count, as reported in October. Explore the open-court map and planning-pipeline preview in Padel Genie.

Conversions out of industrial, warehouse and retail stock rose from 50 applications to 151. The former Homebase on Finchley Road: 10 courts approved under an all-weather canopy. Merlin Way, North Shields: 12 courts approved in a former industrial unit. See all 47 approvals of five courts or more, with addresses, decision dates, court counts and former building use in Padel Genie. Source: August report.

Northern Ireland: 6.52 courts per 100,000 people. Scotland: 2.06. All regions and nations from the October report, ranked on the same measure, with the Great Britain average of 4.5 as a reference. Supply per head is context, not a measure of demand.
